material_context: Digestate from a Greek mesophilic biogas plant treating food-industry waste (80%), animal waste (15%), and agricultural waste (5%); screw-press separated and pasteurized.
applicability: Useful for finding source-published process and nutrient-separation evidence and verifying the paper's study context; it is not a grass digestate and cannot define GreenHub recovery performance.
data_handling: Only public landing-page metadata, file names, sizes, and MD5 values were indexed. No supplementary file content or numerical observations were copied into the repository.
limitations: The digestate substrate is not roadside grass or GreenHub post-protein residual.
The data-use license is not stated on the dataset record; public download does not by itself establish reuse permission.
A direct read-only network request from this workspace was blocked; values remain unverified against the deposited CSV payloads.
Do not use the linked recovery percentages as GreenHub defaults, calibrations, or fertilizer credits.
